title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Shrek?
description: Ten real pictures connect Adolf Hitler to Shrek, through Hindenburg, the Kaiser, Teddy Roosevelt, every president to Reagan, Arnold, Obama, King Charles, Mark Carney and Mike Myers.
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Shrek?

image.file: File:Bundesarchiv Bild 183-S38324, Tag von Potsdam, Adolf Hitler, Paul v. Hindenburg.jpg

links.line: In 1933, Hitler shook hands with President Hindenburg, the old war hero who had just made him chancellor.
In 1917, Hindenburg studied war maps with his boss, Kaiser Wilhelm II, the last emperor of Germany.

image.file: File:Theodore Roosevelt riding on horseback with Kaiser Wilhelm II LCCN2013650883.jpg

links.line: In 1910, the Kaiser took Teddy Roosevelt on horseback to watch the German army practice.

links.line: Teddy Roosevelt was the 26th president, and the line runs all the way to the 40th, Ronald Reagan.

image.file: File:President Ronald Reagan with Arnold Schwarzenegger Retouched.jpg

links.line: In 1984, Reagan met a bodybuilder turned movie star, Arnold, at the Republican convention in Dallas.
In 2009, Arnold walked with Obama in Los Angeles.
